CharacterDescription:
A daughter of Arnolf Karstark, the steward of Karhold and uncle to Lord Rickard Karstark's children. The Karstarks are a divided house in quiet ways — Arnolf has his own ambitions, his own view of what is best for the family, and his own counsel he gives to those who will hear it. His daughter has grown up in that shadow, a young woman of the North with the Karstark coloring — dark, lean, serious-faced.

She is navigating the complicated loyalties of a family within a family: Karstark within Stark, Arnolf's branch within Rickard's. She keeps her own counsel where it is wise to and observes the world around her carefully.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Karhold, two days before Ned Stark's execution. The Karstark men have ridden south with Robb. She remains with the household.
